units.en: Yongming 1, eleventh month, guimao night: a sound rolled from the northeast sky until the wu watch.
units.literal: Yongming the first year, eleventh month, on the night of guimao, sound in the northeast sky until the wu night watch.

units.zh: 《傳》曰：「皇之不極，是謂不建，其咎在霿亂失聽，故厥咎霿。」
units.en: The Commentary says: "When the king misses the Pole, the realm is not established; the blame is muddle and lost counsel — hence the penalty named obscuring."
units.literal: The Commentary says: "When the sovereign does not reach the Pole, this is called not establishing; the fault lies in muddled turmoil and lost hearing, hence the fault is called obscuring."

units.zh: 思心之咎亦霧。
units.en: The fault of a wavering heart is fog as well.
units.literal: The fault of reflective mind is also fog.

units.zh: 天者，正萬物之始，王者，正萬事之始，失中則害天氣，類相動也。
units.en: Heaven aligns the birth of the ten thousand things; the king aligns the birth of ten thousand affairs — lose the center and heaven's qi is wounded; like answers to like.
units.literal: Heaven sets right the beginning of the myriad things; the king sets right the beginning of the myriad affairs — lose the center and you harm the heavenly qi; like kinds stir one another.

units.zh: 天者轉於下而運於上，雲者起於山而彌於天，天氣動則其象應，故厥罰常陰。
units.en: Heaven wheels beneath and runs above; clouds climb from the hills and spread across the sky — stir heaven's qi and the sign answers; hence the penalty called unending yin.
units.literal: Heaven turns below and moves above; clouds rise from mountains and fill the sky — when heavenly qi stirs its image responds, hence the penalty is constant yin.

units.zh: 王者失中，臣下盛強，而蔽君明，則雲陰亦衆多而蔽天光也。
units.en: When the throne loses its center, powerful ministers below eclipse the ruler's light — and cloud-shadow too grows thick until it blinds the sky.
units.literal: When the king loses the center, ministers below grow mighty and obscure the ruler's clarity — then cloudy shade too is many and obscures heaven's light.

units.zh: 建元四年十月丙午，日入后土霧勃勃如火煙。
units.en: In the fourth year of Jianyuan, tenth month, bingwu: after sunset, earth-fog rose thick and pulsing like smoke from a fire.
units.literal: Jianyuan year 4, tenth month, bingwu — after sunset, earth-fog thick and surging like fire-smoke.

units.zh: 永明二年十一月己亥，四面土霧入人眼鼻，至辛丑止。
units.en: Yongming 2, eleventh month, jihai: earth-fog on every side crept into eyes and nose until xinchou, then lifted.
units.literal: Yongming year 2, eleventh month, jihai — earth-fog on all four sides entered eyes and nose until xinchou, when it stopped.

units.zh: 二年十一月丙子，日出後及日入後，四面土霧勃勃如火煙。
units.en: That year, eleventh month, bingzi: after dawn and again after dusk, earth-fog on every side billowed like fire-smoke.
units.literal: Year 2, eleventh month, bingzi — after sunrise and after sunset, earth-fog on all four sides surging like fire-smoke.

units.zh: 六年十一月庚戌，丙夜土霧竟天，昏塞濃厚，至六日未時小開，到甲夜後仍濃密，勃勃如火煙，辛慘，入人眼鼻。
units.en: In the sixth year, eleventh month, gengxu: at the bing watch earth-fog swallowed the sky, dim and suffocating; on the sixth day at wei it thinned a little, but by the first jia watch of night it closed in again, pulsing like flame-smoke, sharp and bitter in eyes and nose.
units.literal: In the sixth year, eleventh month, gengxu — at the bing night watch earth-fog filled heaven, dark and choking thick; on the sixth day at wei hour it opened slightly; by the first jia night watch it was dense again, surging like fire-smoke, harsh and bitter, entering eyes and nose.

units.zh: 八年十月壬申，夜土霧竟天，濃厚勃勃如火煙，氣入人眼鼻，至九日辰時開除。
units.en: In the eighth year, tenth month, renshen: all night earth-fog choked the sky, heavy and smoking like fire, burning eyes and nose; on the ninth, at chen, it finally cleared.
units.literal: In the eighth year, tenth month, renshen — at night earth-fog filled heaven, thick and surging like fire-smoke, qi entering eyes and nose; on the ninth day at chen hour it cleared.

units.zh: 九年十月丙辰，晝夜恒昏霧勃勃如火煙，其氣辛慘，入人眼鼻，兼日色赤黃，至四日甲夜開除。
units.en: In the ninth year, tenth month, bingchen: day and night stayed dim, fog pulsing like fire-smoke, harsh and bitter in eyes and nose, the sun itself turned red-yellow; on the fourth, at the first jia watch, the murk broke.
units.literal: In the ninth year, tenth month, bingchen — day and night constantly dim, fog surging like fire-smoke, the qi harsh and bitter entering eyes and nose, also the sun's color red-yellow; on the fourth day at the first jia night watch it cleared.

units.zh: 十年正月辛酉，酉初四面土霧勃勃如火煙，其氣辛慘入人眼鼻。
units.en: In the tenth year, first month, xinyou: at the opening of you hour fog on every side rose like fire-smoke, sharp and bitter in eyes and nose.
units.literal: In the tenth year, first month, xinyou — at the beginning of you hour on all four sides earth-fog surging like fire-smoke, the qi harsh and bitter entering eyes and nose.

units.en: The Commentary says: "In the Changes, "Qian is the horse."
units.literal: The Commentary says: "The Changes says "Qian is the horse."

units.zh: 逆天氣，馬多死，故曰有馬禍。」
units.en: Turn against heaven's qi and horses die in droves — hence the omen of the horse calamity."
units.literal: Going against heaven's qi, horses mostly die — hence there are horse calamities."

units.zh: 一曰，馬者，兵象也。
units.en: Another reading: the horse images war.
units.literal: Another version: the horse is the image of armies.

units.zh: 將有寇戎之事，故馬爲怪。
units.en: When raids and border war draw near, horses turn monstrous.
units.literal: There will be bandit-and-barbarian affairs — hence horses become strange.

units.zh: 建武四年，王晏出至草市，馬驚走，鼓步從車而歸，十餘日，晏誅。
units.en: Jianwu 4: Wang Yan rode out to Grass Market; his horse panicked and fled; drummers and runners chased the carriage home — within a fortnight Yan was put to death.
units.literal: Jianwu year 4, Wang Yan went out to Grass Market; his horse bolted; drummers and runners followed the carriage back — within ten-odd days Yan was executed.

units.zh: 建武中，南岸有一蘭馬，走逐路上女子，女子窘急，走入人家床下避之，馬終不置，發床食女子股腳間肉都盡。
units.en: In Jianwu a blue horse on the south bank chased women along the road; one, desperate, crawled beneath a household bed — the beast would not relent, tore up the bed, and devoured the flesh from her thighs and legs to the bone.
units.literal: During Jianwu, on the south bank was a blue-coat horse that ran chasing women on the road; one woman, in distress, hid under a bed in a house; the horse would not leave, pulled up the bed, and ate the flesh of the woman's thighs and legs entirely.

units.zh: 禁司以聞，敕殺此馬，是後頻有寇賊。
units.en: The prohibition office reported it; the throne ordered the horse slain — and thereafter raids came again and again.
units.literal: The prohibition office reported it; an edict ordered the horse killed — after that bandits came frequently.

units.zh: 《京房易傳》曰：「生子二胷以上，民謀其主。
units.en: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "A child born with two chests or more — the people plot against their lord.
units.literal: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When a child is born with two chests or more, the people plot against their lord.

units.zh: 三手以上，臣謀其主。
units.en: Three hands or more — ministers plot against their lord.
units.literal: Three hands or more — ministers plot against their lord.

units.zh: 二口已上，國見驚以兵。
units.en: Two mouths or more — the realm is shaken by arms.
units.literal: Two mouths or more — the state is alarmed by armies.

units.zh: 三耳已上，是謂多聽，國事無定。
units.en: Three ears or more — called too many listeners; the state's business never settles.
units.literal: Three ears or more — this is called much listening; state affairs have no fixity.

units.zh: 二鼻以上，國主久病。
units.en: Two noses or more — the sovereign falls into long illness.
units.literal: Two noses or more — the state's lord long ill.

units.zh: 三足三臂已上，天下有兵。」
units.en: Three feet or three arms or more — war under Heaven."
units.literal: Three feet or three arms or more — armies under Heaven."

units.zh: 其類甚多，蓋以象占之。
units.en: The kinds are countless — all are divined by likeness.
units.literal: Such kinds are very many — all are read by image.

units.zh: 永明五年，吳興東遷民吳休之家女人雙生二兒，胷以下齊以上合。
units.en: Yongming 5: in Dongqian, Wuxing, a woman of Wu Xiuzhi's household bore twin boys joined from the chest down and from the navel up.
units.literal: Yongming year 5, a woman of Wu Xiuzhi's household in Dongqian, Wuxing, gave birth to twin boys — joined from the chest down and from the navel up.

units.zh: 《京房易傳》曰：「野獸入邑，其邑大虛。」
units.en: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When wild beasts enter a town, the town is hollowed out."
units.literal: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When wild beasts enter a settlement, that settlement is greatly emptied."

units.zh: 又曰：「野獸無故入邑朝廷門及宮府中者，邑逆且虛。」
units.en: Also: "Beasts that wander without cause into a town, its court gates, or its offices — the town turns traitor and is emptied."
units.literal: Also: "When wild beasts for no reason enter a settlement, the court gates, or government offices — the settlement rebels and is emptied."

units.zh: 永明中，南海王子罕爲南兗州刺史，有麞入廣陵城，投井而死，又有象至廣陵，是後刺史安陸王子敬於鎮被害。
units.en: In Yongming, Prince Zihan of Nanhai governed Southern Yanzhou; a roe deer entered Guangling, leapt into a well, and died; an elephant came to Guangling as well — and later the inspector, Prince Zijing of Anlu, was murdered in his commandery.
units.literal: During Yongming, Prince Zihan of Nanhai was Governor of Southern Yanzhou; a roe deer entered Guangling city and threw itself into a well and died; an elephant also came to Guangling — afterward the Inspector, Prince Zijing of Anlu, was killed at his post.

units.zh: 建武四年春，當郊治圜丘，宿設已畢，夜虎攫傷人。
units.en: Jianwu 4, spring: on the eve of the Round Mound sacrifice, when the night encampment was ready, a tiger broke in after dark and mauled the attendants.
units.literal: Jianwu year 4, spring — when they were to sacrifice at the Round Mound, the overnight arrangements complete, at night a tiger seized and wounded people.

units.zh: 建武中，有鹿入景皇寢廟，皆爲上崩及禪代也。
units.en: During Jianwu, deer entered the shrine of the Jing Emperor; in every case the reading was the sovereign's death and the turning of the age.
units.literal: In the Jianwu era, deer entered the Jing Emperor's resting temple; all were taken as omens of the sovereign's death and the transfer of the Mandate.

units.zh: 凡無占者，皆爲不應本傳。
units.en: In sum, what is recorded without an omen-reading does not answer to this treatise.
units.literal: In general, those without prognostic readings all fail to accord with this treatise.

units.zh: 贊曰：木怪夔魍，火爲水妃。
units.en: In praise: wood breeds the kui and the wangliang; fire is water's bride.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Wood's monsters are the kui and the wangliang; fire is water's consort.

units.zh: 土實載物，金作明威。
units.en: Earth, solid and sustaining, bears the ten thousand things; metal shapes clear dread.
units.literal: Earth, solid, bears and carries things; metal forges bright awe.

units.zh: 形聲異迹，影響同歸。
units.en: Form and voice leave different tracks; shadow and echo find one return.
units.literal: Form and sound differ in their traces; shadow and echo return to one end.

units.zh: 皆由象應，莫不類推。
units.en: All come by signs that answer in kind; none escape reasoning by analogy.
units.literal: All are through image-correspondence; none are not inferred by category.
